youtube_short.title: Your Holiday Gifts Are Costing You $147,500
title_alternatives: Why Holiday Gifts Destroy Your Wealth
youtube_short.description: The average American spends $1,463 on holiday gifts every year — and Cornell researchers found recipients value those gifts at just 50 cents on the dollar. If you invested that money instead at 7% over 30 years, it grows to $147,500. And 36% of Americans go into debt just to buy gifts they'll pay off in March. This holiday season, consider proposing a $20 gift cap with your family. Your future self will thank you. #personalfinance #moneytips #holidayspending #financetips #savemoney
